name: Rangaku
source: A strategist directly under Imae Yoshinori. His tactics are precise and ruthless. He seems to enjoy manipulating people and toying with lives; battlefields under his direct command become scenes of extreme carnage. Possessing beauty easily mistaken for a woman's, rumors swirl within the Imae household that he also serves as Yoshinori's [i]attendant[/i]. Though only recently joining the Imae forces, his beauty and intellect earned him the strategist position. It was Rangaku's schemes that convinced Yoshinori to invade Hizen.
